svg.aria-label: Now: In Prof. Aobo Li’s Rare AI Lab at UC San Diego I work on SIDERIUS, an open-source agent that turns a dataset and a research question into an iterative machine-learning experiment and checks validity beside the score. I test its orchestration mode and run it end to end on Project 8 physics data. If you have a dataset and a question, try it and open an issue. Before: AI Agent Development Intern at Pfizer China R&D (summer 2026): a regulatory-filing system where deterministic code decides and review agents only advise.
